question: The mass number of sulphur atom is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**32**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The mass number of a sulphur atom is **32**.
 
• This mass number is derived from the most common isotope of sulphur, which is **Sulphur-32 (S-32)**.
 
• Sulphur has 16 protons and 16 neutrons, making the total mass number 32.
 
• The atomic number of sulphur is 16, which indicates the number of protons in its nucleus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isotopes of Sulphur**

 
 
• Sulphur has several isotopes, including S-32, S-33, S-34, and S-36.
 
• S-32 is the most abundant isotope, making up about 95% of natural sulphur.
 
• Isotopes differ in the number of neutrons in the nucleus while having the same number of protons.
 
 
 
• **Atomic Structure**
 
 
• An atom consists of protons, neutrons, and electrons.
 
• The number of protons determines the atomic number and the element's identity.
 
• Neutrons contribute to the atom's mass but do not affect its chemical properties.
 
 
 
• **Periodic Table**
 
 
• Sulphur is located in group 16 of the periodic table, also known as the chalcogens.
 
• It is a non-metal and has similar properties to other elements in its group, such as oxygen and selenium.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Properties of Sulphur**
 
 
• Sulphur is known for its bright yellow color in its solid form.
 
• It is commonly found in nature as a pure element and in various minerals.
 
• Sulphur is essential for life as it is a component of amino acids and proteins.
